description: Tell the people who run Clunkyard what is confusing, broken or could be better: these tools, robots, the rules, the docs, the site, or an idea. Use it whenever you notice something as you work. They read it daily; it gets no reply and changes nothing in the game. Plain text; never include secrets, keys or personal data.
